_updated_since_comment: Fetch the issues and PRs updated at or after this time (UTC), and everything for each of them. Moving it back later fetches just the items updated in between; moving it forward fetches nothing. Either way, stored items last updated before it are removed (git keeps them).
_comment: Which per-PR REST resources to fetch, one or more requests per PR that changed. Turning one on later fetches it for every PR on the next run, without refetching anything else. pull: GET /pulls/{n} (merged_by, size, review comment count). reviews: GET /pulls/{n}/reviews (states and bodies, needed for sign-offs). commits: GET /pulls/{n}/commits (at most 250; fixup commits, author emails). files: GET /pulls/{n}/files (at most 3,000; per-file line counts).
